card.name: Inside norm- and dys- medical terms
card.fires_on: The middle piece of long medical words that start with norm- (normochromic, normoglycemia, normokalemia) or dys- (dysesthesias). It fires on the piece right after the opening syllable.

modes.label: norm- words
modes.description: Piece after "norm" in words for normal blood levels or cell appearance.
modes.example: to assure at least two days of norm<<og>>lycemia prior to Fludeoxy

modes.label: dys- words
modes.description: Piece "se" after "dy" in dysesthesias, a nerve symptom.
modes.example: hypoesthesias, dy<<se>>sthesias and weakness have been reported

card.plain: It marks the middle of long medical words like normoglycemia and dysesthesias, where the word is still being spelled out.
